findings.summary: Inactive RU homepage case links were below 4.5:1.
findings.resolution: Raised link color to the existing accessible muted token.

findings.summary: Secondary controls inherited a pink background with light text.
findings.resolution: Restored a dark secondary surface with light text and visible border.

findings.summary: Four result headings overflowed at 320–375 px.
findings.resolution: Reduced excessive card inset and added a bounded mobile type scale without changing copy.

findings.summary: Controls inside an aria-hidden process scene could remain focusable during state changes.
findings.resolution: Inactive process scenes now receive inert in the same synchronous state update.

findings.summary: Several expectations and snapshots described pre-Aurora approved styling.
findings.resolution: Updated semantic expectations and refreshed validated visual baselines.

findings.summary: Lazy-image and motion geometry assertions raced browser loading and transitions.
findings.resolution: Asserted declared src values, waited for intrinsic loading, and measured geometry with reduced motion.
